ios.desc:
Smart PDF Converter is your complete PDF toolkit — simple, powerful, and lightning fast. Convert images, manage documents, and scan anything into professional-quality PDFs — all in one easy-to-use app.
Key Features:
* Image to PDF Converter: Instantly turn photos, screenshots, or scanned documents into high-quality PDFs.
* PDF to Image Converter: Export your PDF pages as images (JPEG/PNG) — perfect for sharing or editing.
* Merge Multiple PDFs: Combine multiple PDF files into one organized document effortlessly.
* Split PDF Pages: Extract or split pages from a large PDF file in seconds.
* Document Scanner: Use your iPhone or iPad camera to scan receipts, notes, or documents into clear, editable PDFs.
Why Choose Smart PDF Converter?
* Intuitive design — no learning curve
* 100% offline — your files never leave your device
* Fast processing and accurate conversions
* Share PDFs via email, AirDrop, or cloud apps (Files, Drive, Dropbox, etc.)
* Works perfectly on iPhone & iPad
SUBSCRIPTION INFORMATION: Smart PDF Converter offers auto-renewable subscription options:
* Monthly Plan – $19.99/month
* Yearly Plan – $50/year
Payment will be charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase. Subscription automatically renews unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage and cancel subscriptions in your App Store account settings.
Privacy Policy: https://praveenraman.github.io/privacy-policy.html Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Turn your iOS device into a portable PDF powerhouse — for school, office, or personal use. Download Smart PDF Converter today and manage your documents the smart way!
